_not_minted_deliberately._comment: Prototype strings this group DROPS rather than keys. Each is a PROMISE, and a promise cannot be em-dashed the way a missing value can — so it is dropped, not translated. The sidecar test asserts that NO slot of ANY of the four sidecars resolves to text containing these, which also blocks smuggling the claim back in by pointing a slot at an existing dict id.
_not_minted_deliberately.ctaSurvey: 'ปิดงาน + ส่งแบบประเมิน' (L305). The close happens; the satisfaction survey does not exist — service_ticket has no rating column and POST /sales/service/:id/close explicitly IGNORES a client {rating} (apps/api/src/routes/sales-service.ts L354-359). The button ships as sales.service.statusClosed ('ปิดงาน'), which is exactly what it does. NOTE: the merged WEB port still renders btnCloseEval for the same op, so BLOCKERS.md B-294 asks Wei to reconcile the two surfaces; if fidelity wins, that key already exists and the slot points at it with NO mint.
_not_minted_deliberately.reschedule: 'เลื่อนนัด' (L244). There is no reschedule op on the route at all (the machine is received -> scheduled -> fixing -> fixed -> closed, sales-service.ts L21-27). B-294.
_not_minted_deliberately.fixAndClose: 'ซ่อมเสร็จ + ปิดงาน' (L247). No single op moves `fixing` to `closed`; the machine's move from `fixing` is `fix`, and the close is a separate move from `fixed`. The label promises two steps the server will not take. B-294.
_not_minted_deliberately.appointCustomer: 'นัดลูกค้า' (L249). The `schedule` op notifies nobody — there is no customer notification anywhere in this route. B-294.
_not_minted_deliberately.ratingTile: 'เรตติ้ง' (L216) and its '★4.8' value. No rating column exists, so the whole third stat tile is omitted — neither a label nor a value. B-294.
_not_minted_deliberately.photosField: 'รูปประกอบ (อย่างน้อย 1 รูป)' (L94). service_ticket has NO photo column and this route has no upload seam, so the label plus its '+' tile would promise an attachment that is silently discarded — and the prototype marks it REQUIRED, a rule nothing here could honour. B-293.
_not_minted_deliberately.preferredSlot: 'นัดวันสะดวก' (L106). Not a missing column but a WRONG one: scheduled_date means 'the appointment that was set'. B-293.
_not_minted_deliberately.draftButton: 'บันทึกร่าง' (L112). The machine's start state is `received` and it has no draft state at all. B-293.
_not_minted_deliberately.signHint: 'เซ็นที่นี่' (L297). There is no signature column, so no pad is drawn — capturing a mark nobody stores is the fabrication this port exists to avoid, and adding a signature-pad package is a Wei-level stack decision (the geolocator / B-260 precedent). B-294.
_not_minted_deliberately.warrantyCardTitle: 'Warranty ยูนิต B-08' (L180) is OMITTED, not truncated: it embeds a unit CODE this app cannot resolve (unit_id is a project_node uuid with no label endpoint — the merged web port em-dashes the same field), and minting the fragment 'Warranty ยูนิต' would be inventing copy that appears nowhere in the prototype.
